contact.basis: Fixed dry Second Avenue entrance approach three metres outward from original west facade, before terrain/geometry. Uphill street/sidewalk and threshold/basement datum are approximate, with no fitted terrain or site platform.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in native Alaska Building original street-edge frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.1m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Composite urban heights may include/interpolate structure and vegetation; exact street/threshold/basement classification is unspecified. Compatible host field required; default coarse terrain is not automatically certified.
